nameEn: Wholesale of food, beverages and tobacco
description: This class includes the wholesale of food, beverages and tobacco products.
includes: wholesale of dairy products, eggs and edible oils and fats
wholesale of meat and meat products
wholesale of fish, crustaceans and molluscs and other aquatic products
wholesale of sugar, chocolate and sugar confectionery
wholesale of coffee, tea, cocoa and spices
wholesale of other food: bread, bakery, pastry and confectionery products
wholesale of beverages: spirits, wine, beer, soft drinks, fruit juices
wholesale of canned and dry goods
excludes: wholesale of agricultural raw materials, see 4620
